description: This file defines a service for managing links in a React frontend, using Supabase as backend. It includes functions for listing, creating, updating, deleting, and analyzing links associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: useLinksService()
methods.description: Main hook providing link-related operations for the frontend.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Fetches links for the current user with filtering, sorting, and search options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new link for the authenticated user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing link owned by the user.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a link owned by the user.

methods.name: incrementClicks
methods.description: Increments the click count for a specific link.

methods.name: analytics
methods.description: Provides aggregate statistics (total links and total clicks) for the current user.
